The '''Corodex Snare''' was a type of [[snare gun]] used by [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]].<ref name="GG11" />

A favorite of [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] strike teams throughout the galaxy, the Corodex Snare was a passive restraint weapon capable of rendering a target completely immobile in a matter of seconds.<ref name="GG11" /> A tubular rifle, the device launched a cone of chemically treated high-tensile filaments.<ref name="GG11" /> On striking an object, these filaments coil themselves tightly around the intended target, while simultaneously beginning to expand and contract.<ref name="GG11" /> Within seconds, the wires fuse themselves into a hard cocoon like shell, effectively incapacitating the victim within.<ref name="GG11" />
